Project.NAME: PaymentService (MIF)
Project.keywords: mif, payment-processing, swift, cqrs, dapr, wolverine, mongodb, k8s, saga, reader, writer, worker
Project.annotation: High-throughput SWIFT-like payment processing microservice in MIF. CQRS: Reader (query-only), Writer (command gateway), Worker (saga processor).

M-SHARED.NAME: SharedContracts
M-SHARED.purpose: Shared DTOs, events, commands across Reader, Writer, Worker.

M-READER.NAME: PaymentService.Api.ReaderService
M-READER.purpose: Query-only API: MongoDB direct reads, no saga involvement, fast response.

M-WRITER.NAME: PaymentService.Api.WriterService
M-WRITER.purpose: Command gateway: routes commands to MQ via Dapr pub/sub, returns 202 Accepted.

M-WORKER.NAME: PaymentService.WorkerService
M-WORKER.purpose: Saga processor: subscribes to MQ PaymentCommand, executes saga, persists to MongoDB.

class-PaySaga.PURPOSE: Wolverine saga: validate → enrich → settle → notify with compensation

M-MONGO.NAME: PaymentService.Persistence
M-MONGO.purpose: Payment documents, saga state, idempotency ledger, transactions.

export-IPaymentDocumentRepository.PURPOSE: CRUD for payment documents (Reader reads, Worker writes)

CrossLink.relation: persists saga state and payment documents
